subject: Proposal: 6-week Integrator Shadow Rotation & Capstone
messages:
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Beth Gardner <beth@edgeops.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: 6-week Integrator Shadow Rotation & Capstone

Hi Beth,

Following our conversation at Partner Summit, we'd like to propose a structured 6-week "Integrator Shadow Rotation" for EdgeOps SDEs and SEs to accelerate hands-on expertise with the Redwood platform and produce a short capstone (joint delivery proof-of-concept). High level:

- Week 0 (prep): access, tooling, and learning path assigned
- Weeks 1-4: paired shadowing with Redwood solution engineers (live setups, debug sessions, joint demos)
- Week 5: independent mini-sprint (partner-led) with Redwood office hours
- Week 6: capstone demo + retrospective and pass/fail rubric

Goal: enable two EdgeOps engineers to reach delivery-readiness for small SI engagements (integration, troubleshooting, rollout). Expected outcomes: runbook handoff, 1 capstone repo, checklist of infra prerequisites.

We have a short syllabus and access checklist attached. Can you confirm the two engineers you'd like to nominate and any blackout windows in Sept/Oct? Also tell us if you need any compliance/POC scoping changes.

Attachments: rotation-syllabus.pdf (pdf), access-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Beth Gardner <beth@edgeops.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 6-week Integrator Shadow Rotation & Capstone

Hi Hiro —

This looks great and timely. EdgeOps is keen. I can confirm two nominees: Carlos Rivera (SE) and Priya Sen (SWE). They both have some prior exposure to Redwood demos but would benefit from deeper operational experience.

Blackout windows: Carlos is on PTO Sept 21–24; Priya is available all month except Sept 30 afternoon.

A couple quick asks:
- Can the capstone accept a small customer-facing checklist we own (we prefer co-branded deliverables)?
- Do you have any constraints around providing access to a staging project that includes S3-compatible storage?

Happy to jump on a 30m call if helpful.

Best,
Beth
Beth Gardner
Head of Integrations | EdgeOps Consulting
beth@edgeops.com
(206) 555-0142

Date: 2026-09-05T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 6-week Integrator Shadow Rotation & Capstone

Thanks Beth + Hiro —

Quick answers: we can absolutely support a co-branded capstone deliverable and will include a lightweight IP/attribution stub in the handoff doc. For staging storage, we can provision an S3-compatible bucket in the Redwood partner sandbox; we'll only ask for minimal sample data (no PII) per our onboarding checklist.

Hiro — can you add a proposed start date? If we aim for the week of Sept 28 that avoids Carlos's PTO and gives us two weeks to set up access. I'll start a calendar hold for the weekly paired sessions (Tue/Thu 9–11am PT) and a standing Friday office hour.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Partner Success | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Proposal: 6-week Integrator Shadow Rotation & Capstone

Morning —

I've attached a lightweight evaluation template we'll use to score the capstone and weekly checkpoints (rotation-eval-template.csv). Key metrics we care about:
- Independent delivery: can the partner reproduce a full setup end-to-end?
- Troubleshooting latency: time-to-first-diagnosis on a standard failure injection
- Playbook completeness: are runbooks clear and runnable by a third engineer

Proposed pass threshold: all metrics green or >80% across rubric, OR documented remediation plan + follow-up mini-cycle.

Beth — we'll also want quick access to a contact on your side for follow-up items (deploy keys, infra setup). Can Carlos be the primary contact? If not, who should we add to the access-checklist?

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>

Thanks all — finalizing schedule below and attaching the final syllabus + access checklist. Please review and ack by EOD Monday so we can provision sandbox resources the following morning.

Start: Week of 2026-09-28
Weekly cadence: Tue/Thu 09:00–11:00 PT (paired sessions) + Fri 10:00–11:00 PT office hour
Capstone week: 2026-11-02 (demo slot: Nov 6, 9:00–10:00 PT)
Primary partner contacts: Carlos Rivera (c.rivera@edgeops.com), Priya Sen (p.sen@edgeops.com)

Attachments included: rotation-syllabus.pdf, access-checklist.xlsx, rotation-eval-template.csv

Related links: partner sandbox drive (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3crotation), HubSpot record HUBSPOT-123456

If that schedule works I'll ask Ops to provision the S3-compatible bucket and create short-lived IAM creds tied to the partner sandbox.

—Hiro
